pages.title: Tetrameryx
pages.text: $(o)Tetrameryx$() ($(o)Tetrameryx shuleri$()) is an extinct relative of the pronghorn that lived in North America during the Pleistocene.$(br2)Like the pronghorn, it was not a true antelope but a member of the family Antilocapridae.$(br2)As its name suggests, it had four horns: each of its two horn cores split into a pair of prongs.
